issue_context.title: The background color of the drop-down is incorrect when choosing an default enum form the Supabase dashboard
issue_context.body:
# Bug report

- [X] I confirm this is a bug with Supabase, not with my own application. 
- [X] I confirm I have searched the [Docs](https://docs.supabase.com), GitHub [Discussions](https://github.com/supabase/supabase/discussions), and [Discord](https://discord.supabase.com). 

## Describe the bug

When choosing a default value for a created enum, the dropdown background colour is white and the text is also white, white hovering over the list the background  color of the text is black

## To Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behaviour,

1. Create a new column, by clicking on Insert a column form the dashboard
2. Chose  the type of column to be an enum type you have already created
3. Select one of the default type 

## Screenshots

If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.
![image](https://github.com/supabase/supabase/assets/55092280/dc047c38-7d78-466e-9635-4f9509486dbb)


## System information

- OS: [Linux Ubuntu]
- Browser: Chrome
